name: Structure: Fix the rule that the hypothesis has no page and the correction is the check-in's
markdown_description:
P5, P10, P13, P15, and P48, the one thing on the S12 page a later session cannot revise at ordinary cost. A lead's reading of a person is said at the check-in, once, as an observation of behavior and impact, and is written nowhere; the only record of coaching is the person's own line; during service the only speech about a person's work is the range's call on the object; and no coaching record exists for any later mechanism to cite. A later session may design what Session 14 does with the count of a hypothesis heard and declined, what Session 15 does with a lead's own hypothesis and a lead who over-places, what Session 13 does with a review that opens on the person's lines, and what the reset does with the placed count; no later session may give the hypothesis a page, let a lead's observation onto any record about a person, move the correction into a room or onto the floor, or cite a coaching record this page ensures does not exist. Written as a structural rule on the mechanism map beside Session 6's four dimensions, Session 9's order of every read, Session 10's rule that the environment names no person in a room (`86akht2k9`), and Session 11's rule that nothing reaches the house that is not on a record first (`17tn048qc3y`).
